text:
asked grok how Buffett managed his factor exposures in 1960 when he was long so many textile manufacturers + his view on setup into qtr

"When Buffett bought both a textile manufacturer and that Dempster Mill company, how did he manage his factor exposure? Usually risk would want you short a textile manufacturer with similar exposures. Also if you could help lay out his pitch in quarterly preview/EPA format, like ests vs street, catalyst path, variant view, and any alt data for Dempster Mill."

not sure the response is the worst or best thing I've ever read

pretty sure worst although like most LLM work, it appears sturdy at first

then u see

"1960's alt data: NOL"

but is that from YipItData, or 1010, or M Sci, you cant have a NOL without primary research and data support

catalyst path "acquires the entire company" without shorting nebraska furniture mart against it

overall grade 3/10 (just like the question)
